title: Clause and term evaluations under negation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $C$ be a term on the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, and let $x$ be a point of that cube. The clause evaluation of $C$ at the coordinatewise negation of $x$ equals $1$ if and only if the term evaluation of $C$ at $x$ equals $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a term on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$x$ is a point of the sign cube of dimension $n$
